tour.welcomeBody: A read-first code IDE: read the code calmly, annotate it, let an agent do the edits. Here's the loop — about 30 seconds.
tour.readBody: Open files from the tree and move through the code. Mark files as read to keep your place across a long session.
tour.commentBody: Select lines and press {key} to leave a note or a task. Comments are an overlay — they never change your code.
tour.tasksBody: Every note and task collects here, with its state: open, in progress, done.
tour.reviewBody: Pick a scope and an objective; the agent plans a route through the changes for you to review file by file.
tour.resolveBody: Launch an agent in the terminal: it reads your open tasks and resolves them via the reado CLI. You review, the agent commits.
tour.customizeBody: Theme, code font, font size and reading aids — all in Settings, anytime.

anywhere.open: Reado Anywhere — review from your phone

anywhere.privacyNote: No account, no cloud. Works on the same network, or anywhere over a VPN.
anywhere.primeTitle: macOS will ask for local network access

anywhere.lifetimeHint: A paired phone must pair again after this long unused, or this long in total. 0 turns a limit off.
anywhere.mdnsHint: Lets a paired phone find this desktop again without a fresh QR. The announcement carries the address only — a phone still needs its credential.

settings.title: Settings
settings.completionSound: Play a sound when the agent finishes
settings.rulerHint: A vertical line at this column marks where lines are getting long. 0 turns it off.
settings.wrapHint: Long lines wrap to the next row instead of scrolling sideways.
settings.stickyHint: Pin the enclosing function/scope headers at the top while you scroll inside them.
settings.semanticTokensHint: Colour from the language server on top of the grammar's — it knows a type from a value, a parameter from a local.
settings.codeLensHint: Show the language server's “3 references” / “2 implementations” lines above a symbol; click one to go there.
settings.colorSwatchesHint: Show a swatch beside every colour in the file; click it to pick a new one
settings.whitespaceHint: Show spaces and tabs as faint marks.
settings.bracketMatchingHint: When the caret sits beside a bracket, highlight its matching one.
settings.focusHint: Dim everything except the block — function, tag, or scope — around the caret.
settings.cliDone: Installed at {path}. If `reado` isn't found, add that folder to your PATH.
settings.cliHint: Links the bundled 'reado' CLI so AI agents can read and resolve your tasks from any project.
settings.logHint: Logs what the app does to a local file you can send us to debug an issue. Secrets and file contents are never written.
settings.excludeHint: One glob per line (e.g. node_modules, dist, *.log). Applied on top of .gitignore.
settings.restoreSessionHint: Reopen a project's tabs and scroll position, or start with a clean workspace.
settings.trimTrailingWhitespaceHint: Remove spaces/tabs at the end of lines when saving (never on read).
settings.insertFinalNewlineHint: Ensure the file ends with a newline when saving.
settings.showResolvedCommentsHint: Keep resolved comment threads visible in the code, or hide them to declutter — nothing is deleted.
settings.inlineDiagnosticsHint: Draw error/warning squiggles in the editor. Off still keeps the Problems panel and tree counts.
settings.fileIconsHint: Show a distinct icon for each file type in the tree.
settings.largeFileGuardHint: Ask before opening a text file above this size, instead of loading it. 0 turns the guard off.
settings.inlineBlameHint: Annotate the line the cursor is on with who last changed it, and when.
settings.diffGutterHint: Mark lines in the editor that differ from the last commit.
settings.codeFontCustomHint: Any monospace font installed on this machine, by name. Leave empty to use the choice above.
settings.letterSpacingHint: Extra space between characters. Wider spacing measurably helps dyslexic readers; 0 is the standard rendering.
settings.colorVisionRedGreen: Hard to tell red from green (deuteranopia, protanopia)
settings.colorVisionBlueYellow: Hard to tell blue from yellow (tritanopia)
settings.colorVisionHint: Recolours the places where colour carries meaning on its own — the diff, and errors versus warnings. Your theme is unchanged.
settings.formatOnSaveHint: Run the project's formatter before writing. A formatter that fails never blocks the save.
settings.iconThemeHint: File icons from an installed extension. Reado's glyphs fill in wherever the theme has none.
settings.themeFollowing: Following your system appearance — picking a theme switches to Manual.
settings.resetOne: Reset this setting to Reado's default
settings.suggestOnTypingHint: Off, the completion list opens only on ⌃Space. It always includes the words already in the document.
settings.bracketPairColorsHint: Tints each ()[]{} by how deeply it nests, and underlines a closer with no opener.
settings.autoSaveDelayHint: How long “After Delay” waits after you stop typing.
settings.searchExcludeHint: One glob per line. Empty means the search uses the tree's list above.
settings.terminalShellHint: Absolute path, or empty for your login shell.
settings.terminalShellArgsHint: One per line, passed before the shell starts.
settings.editorconfigNote: A project's .editorconfig wins over these for its own files.
settings.fromProjectHint: This project sets it in .reado/config.json, so it applies here and everywhere else it is opened.
settings.jsonHint: The same preferences as text — diffable, pasteable, and editable. Applying writes every value Reado recognises.
settings.fileNestingHint: Tucks a lock file under its manifest, and a compiled file under its source, so the tree shows what you wrote rather than what a tool produced.
settings.fileNestingRulesHint: One rule per line, `parent : child, child`. ${capture} is what the parent's * matched. Empty uses Reado's own set.
settings.previewTabsHint: A file you click into opens as a preview and is replaced by the next one. Double-click it, edit it, or pin it to keep it.
settings.wrapColumnHint: Where a wrapped line breaks. 0 wraps at the editor's edge.
settings.columnSelectionHint: Drag without holding Alt to select a rectangle. Alt-drag always does.
settings.formatOnPasteHint: Re-indent pasted code to where it lands. The pasted block keeps its own shape; the rest of the file is untouched.
settings.formatOnTypeHint: Let the language server re-format after the characters it asks about, such as a closing brace. Does nothing without a server.
settings.terminalProfilesHint: One per line, as `Name = command args`. They appear beside the + button in the terminal.
settings.defaultTerminalProfileHint: The profile a new terminal runs. Empty means the shell above.
settings.screenReaderHint: Reado cannot tell whether a screen reader is running, so this is a choice rather than a guess. Off, the live region stays silent.
settings.audioCuesHint: A short tone for an error under the caret, and for a finished test run.
